The team Kraken's Consumer Growth team is responsible for acquiring and growing high-quality customers globally across Kraken and Krak. We are looking for an experienced affiliate operator to own and scale our existing affiliate programme and build the Consumer KOL and creator strategy. This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant autonomy. You will set the global affiliate and KOL strategy, directly own affiliate and KOL execution in North America, and work closely with regional KOL and affiliate colleagues across LATAM, Europe and APAC as this distributed team grows over time. You will decide which affiliate and KOL partners to recruit, scale, improve or exit; determine how channel budgets are allocated across partners; and personally lead our most important partner relationships. Success means incremental funded customers who retain and create long-term value, achieving our payback targets — not more links, clicks or low-cost sign-ups. This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant autonomy. You will set channel direction, make portfolio and investment decisions, and remain hands-on with strategic partners. Success means incremental funded customers who retain and create long-term value—not more links, clicks or low-cost sign-ups. The Opportunity Own and scale the global affiliate programme across Kraken and Krak. Set strategy, partner and market priorities, and investment allocation against funded customers, retained revenue, LTV, CAC, ROI and fully loaded payback. Include all affiliate and KOL costs—retainers, CPA, revenue share, flat fees, incentives, and attributable production or activation costs—in those decisions. Build direct relationships with valuable affiliates, publishers, comparison sites, communities, creators and KOLs; use networks and agencies selectively, not as a substitute for partner craft. Segment the portfolio by audience, model, market and customer quality. Design and negotiate CPA, revenue share, hybrid or quality-weighted terms that align incentives with sustainable value. Remain hands-on with strategic partners through evaluation, onboarding, offers, content, landing experience, verification, funding, first use and retention. Diagnose where performance is gained or lost. Work with Data to create partner-level cohort views and tests that separate last-click attribution from incremental growth. Bring clear hypotheses and context; do not wait for analysts to frame the business question. Decide which partners to scale, improve, cap or exit based on downstream economics and customer experience—not top-of-funnel volume alone. Protect the channel from brand bidding, coupon interception, promotional abuse, fraud and low-quality traffic, working with Compliance and other partners on practical controls and escalation paths. Build the Consumer KOL and creator strategy, personally recruiting, activating and scaling high-potential KOLs and creators. Set objectives, briefs, commercial models and measurement suited to each partnership; do not force every creator into a performance-affiliate model. Adapt strategy to local customer motivations, barriers, language, regulation and channel ecosystems. Build repeatable workflows with Performance Marketing, Product, Creative and regional teams, using AI to improve sourcing, analysis, content operations and monitoring while retaining human judgement and compliance review. What You Bring Required A track record of owning and scaling an affiliate programme as a hands-on operator, with clear examples of improving customer and revenue economics. Commercial judgement across CPA, revenue share, hybrid and incentive structures, including the ability to calculate fully loaded payback and explain why a deal creates sustainable value. Experience sourcing, negotiating and growing direct partner relationships, including high-value or sensitive accounts. The ability to interrogate partner, funnel, cohort and retention data and work fluently with Data to test hypotheses and make investment decisions. International experience adapting offers, partner mix, content and operating approach to local customer behaviour and regulatory constraints. Practical command of affiliate tracking, attribution, fraud and abuse controls, and brand and compliance standards. A builder's mindset: you create missing processes, share learning, and use AI or automation where it improves speed and quality without outsourcing judgement. This is a role for someone who wants to sit close to how global commodity markets actually move. You will combine strong SQL and Python skills with a curiosity about the real-world events shaping those movements - from shifting trade flows and supply chain disruptions to changes in industrial demand, policy, and pricing dynamics. You won’t just be processing data. You will play a key role in turning complex, high-volume datasets into reliable market intelligence used by clients to understand what is happening in global physical markets.   • Serve as a scientific subject-matter expert, translating clinical evidence, stakeholder insights, and emerging scientific developments into balanced, actionable recommendations for Medical Affairs strategy.

  • Develop and maintain compliant relationships with key thought leaders (KTLs), healthcare professionals, and other external scientific experts.

  • Plan and conduct scientific exchanges, advisory boards, roundtables, consensus initiatives, and other external engagements aligned with Medical Affairs objectives.

  • Develop KTL engagement plans, define interaction objectives, document scientific insights, and coordinate appropriate follow-up with Medical Affairs leadership.

  • Provide scientific coverage at national and selected regional congresses, including program assessment, session prioritization, coverage planning, KTL preparation, insight capture, and post-congress reporting.

  • Lead the scientific strategy and execution of Medical Affairs booths, including educational content, scientific exchange, medical inquiry routing, insight collection, and post-congress analysis.

  • Partner with Medical Affairs Operations on congress logistics, vendors, contracts, and budget administration.

  • Lead or support scientific communications, including medical education materials, congress resources, presentations, standard response letters, FAQs, and other non-promotional materials.

  • Support publication activities such as publication planning, literature reviews, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and white papers in accordance with applicable governance processes.

  • Conduct literature surveillance and synthesize relevant scientific, clinical, safety, and competitive developments, identifying implications for evidence generation, education, and stakeholder engagement.

  • Aggregate and analyze insights from KTL interactions, congresses, advisory boards, Medical Information, surveys, and research activities to identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities.

  • Represent Medical Affairs on cross-functional teams and provide scientific expertise to Regulatory, Quality, Commercial, and other internal stakeholders as appropriate.

  • Serve as a trained and designated backup for defined Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities, including medical inquiry review or escalation, safety information escalation, and selected product complaint assessments.

  • Support continuous improvement across Medical Affairs processes while maintaining high standards of scientific quality, compliance, and risk management.

    • Advanced scientific or healthcare degree such as a PharmD, PhD, MD, DO, or another relevant advanced degree.

    • Four or more years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience preferred, including experience within Medical Affairs.

    • Strong scientific and clinical acumen, including knowledge of medical terminology, clinical study design, biostatistics, evidence appraisal, and interpretation of clinical and real-world evidence.

    • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and synthesize complex scientific, clinical, safety, and technical information and translate findings into clear, balanced recommendations.

    • Strong scientific writing and communication capabilities, including experience developing medical education materials, evidence summaries, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, presentations, and other scientific content.

    • Working knowledge of publication standards, copyright requirements, scientific exchange principles, and applicable Medical Affairs laws, regulations, industry guidance, and internal requirements.

    • Ability to establish credible and compliant relationships with KTLs, healthcare professionals, and external scientific experts.

    • Strong presentation skills and the ability to adapt complex scientific information for scientific, executive, and cross-functional audiences.

    • Strategic thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to connect scientific evidence and stakeholder insights with broader Medical Affairs priorities.

    • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence cross-functional stakeholders while maintaining appropriate Medical Affairs independence.

    • Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, complex workstreams, and time-sensitive deliverables.

    • Ability to aggregate and synthesize insights to identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities.

    • Strong awareness of quality, compliance, and risk, including the ability to recognize and appropriately escalate safety, product quality, and compliance information.

    • Prior experience in Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, or product complaints is preferred; the ability to complete role-based training and provide designated backup support is required.

    • Experience with KTL engagement, scientific exchange, congress planning or coverage, and scientific communications is preferred.

    • Strong organizational, stakeholder-management, communication, and presentation skills.

    • High degree of accountability, adaptability, integrity, discretion, and commitment to continuous improvement.

    • Ability to work independently within a lean, cross-functional environment and exercise sound judgment when managing competing priorities and potential risks.

    • Fluent English communication skills and willingness to travel overnight up to approximately 20%, including for scientific congresses and external stakeholder engagements.

    • Flexibility to occasionally work evenings or weekends when required by congress schedules or external engagements.

      • Benefits

      • Eligibility for an annual performance bonus.

      • Comprehensive employee benefits package.

      • Remote working arrangement.

      • Approximately 20% travel, providing opportunities for scientific congress participation and external stakeholder engagement.

      • Opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, purpose-driven healthcare environment.

description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London). We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process. This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing. Functions of the Role Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices , developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility. Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight , identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping. Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure , creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments. Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift. Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers , providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield. Build scalable characterisation processes , establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams. Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology , bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales. We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation. Experience - Essentials Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline. 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment. Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows. Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing. Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. Experience - Desirable It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in: Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping. Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems. Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis. Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation. Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.

  • Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description: <div> <p><strong>Senior Customer Success Manager (Enterprise)</strong></p> <p>Location: London | Department: Revenue| Employment type: Full Time</p> <br> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to join us here at GWI. Not just any Senior Customer Success Manager though. Someone ambitious and genuine, who works best in the midst of a collaborative and forward-thinking team. That’s because as a GWIer you’ll be immersed in the fast-moving world of data tech. We think big to make an impact,, we’re not afraid to <strong>ask why</strong> and we always <strong>show respect</strong>. Those values are what got us where we are today, and they’re a big part of what we’re looking for in you.</p> <br> <h1><strong>About the job</strong></h1> <p>The Enterprise Customer Success team at GWI is responsible for helping clients to achieve their desired outcomes through the adoption and practical application of our product and data sets. This is achieved through proactive relationship building, education, and consultative support.</p> <br> <h1><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h1> <p>Working within our Enterprise Customer Success team, you will be part of a global account team assuming ownership and management of the relationship of some of our largest clients, helping them to realise value and support growth.</p> <br> <ul> <li>Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and end users&nbsp;</li> <li>Consult clients on how to solve challenges &amp; achieve desired outcomes with GWI</li> <li>Create success plans to document and track the achievement of desired outcomes</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Identify and support growth opportunities with your AM counterparts</li> <li>Pull, interpret, and deliver regular usage reports for each of your accounts.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Collaborate with the global team to develop and execute strategies for lapsed user engagement, creation of onboarding collateral and project support</li> <li>Accurately forecast risk with account manager and develop a plan to mitigate</li> <li>Working closely with other internal teams to help deliver custom projects and strategic workshops</li> <li>Be the voice of the customer and channel feedback to relevant departments.</li> </ul> <br> <h1><strong>About you</strong></h1> <p>First things first, as a disruptor in the global market research industry, we haven’t come this far without entrepreneurial spirit and a get-up-and-go attitude. So if you think we’ll see that in you, then you’re already halfway there. Here’s the rest of what we’d like you to bring to the table.</p> <br> <h2><strong>Essential</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in a Customer Success, or Account Management role</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills and experience building strong internal and external relationships</li> <li>Strong Analytical skills with a high attention to detail.</li> <li>Proactive, curious-minded, and organized team player with innovative ideas to inspire customer engagement, loyalty, and adoption</li> <li>Ability to bring data to life with stories and present with confidence.</li> <li>Passion for building trust and communicating effectively with customers</li> <li>Ability to work autonomously and look for improvements in ways or working and processes</li> <li>Natural ability to switch between different roles and wear different hats.&nbsp;</li> <li>Highly organized and able to juggle multiple tasks with competing deadlines</li> <li>Customer focused mindset, with a natural ability to relate to clients and understand their issues - while delivering a high level of customer service.</li> </ul> <br> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience working in a Customer Success or Support team</li> <li>Experience working at a SaaS business or with market research/audience profiling data</li> <li>Experience using tools such as Intercom, Salesforce, Mixpanel, SalesLoft, Zendesk, etc.&nbsp;</li> </ul> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>What We Offer 🧘</h1> <p>At GWI, you’ll find meaningful work, visible impact, and a culture that empowers you to do your best. Our package includes:</p> <ul> <li>Time to recharge – 25 days’ annual leave, plus office closures over the holidays.</li> <li>Health &amp; wellbeing – Health cash plan, enhanced family benefits, carer days, and mental health support.</li> <li>Financial benefits – Competitive salary, 4% pension matching, and recognition programs that celebrate success.</li> <li>Flexibility &amp; balance – Flexitime, early Friday finishes, hybrid and remote options, plus a “work from home” budget.</li> <li>Career growth – Accredited learning, leadership development, and global career mobility.</li> <li>Community &amp; impact – DE&amp;I initiatives, volunteering opportunities, donation matching, and payroll giving.</li> </ul> <p>Put all that together and GWI is the friendliest, most fulfilling place any of us has ever worked.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>Diversity, Equity &amp; Inclusion 🫶</h1> <p>Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.</p> <p>As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.</p> <p>We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.</p> <p>At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/2g0akAyAlUU?si=dIgYyrKaAlNZK-NQ" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>#li-hybrid<br>#LI-</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Director – Field Service / Facilities Management
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>The Joblogic Story</strong></h3> <p>Established in 1998,&nbsp;<strong>Joblogic</strong> is the UK’s #1 <strong>Field Service Management</strong> (FSM) software platform. We are a global business with offices in the <strong>UK</strong>, <strong>Pakistan</strong>, and <strong>Vietnam</strong>. Since our management buy-out in 2013, we have grown from <strong>~£500K </strong>ARR to <strong>~£35M+ </strong>ARR and expanded our team from 11 to 500+ people.</p> <p>Recently, we secured a strategic growth investment from <strong>Vista Equity Partners </strong>— a global technology investor specialising in enterprise software. This investment includes over <strong>£100</strong> million in new primary capital and will fuel our next phase of growth by accelerating our <strong>AI-first roadmap</strong>, expanding our platform into CAFM (Computer-Aided Facilities Management) capabilities, and supporting our expansion across Europe and beyond.</p> <p>With <strong>Vista’s </strong>backing, we’re transforming from a successful UK business into a global scaling SaaS rocket ship, and we’d love for you to join us on our journey to <strong>£100M </strong>ARR across international markets.</p> <p><strong>Joblogic </strong>provides software to service contractors who install and maintain the built environment. Our platform helps businesses streamline operations, improve profitability, ensure compliance, and achieve rapid growth. With over <strong>100,000</strong> users across industries including HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management, and building fabric maintenance, we are entering a new era of intelligent automation, predictive maintenance, and data-driven decision-making for service firms.</p></div><p>We're hiring a&nbsp;<strong>Product Director </strong>to lead the strategy, vision, and execution of Joblogic's product portfolio across Field Service and Facilities Management. This is a senior leadership role for someone with <strong>broad product expertise, deep domain understanding, strong people leadership and mentoring skills, and a proven ability to design, build, and scale AI-powered products</strong> in B2B SaaS.</p> <p>You'll own the product vision and roadmap across our entire FSM and CAFM platform, lead, grow, and mentor a high-performing product team, and partner with the executive team to translate market opportunity into commercial outcomes. You'll also be the driving force behind our AI-first product agenda — defining where AI delivers genuine value, embedding intelligence into core workflows, and ensuring we ship responsibly and at pace.</p> <p>Above all, this is a people leadership role. You'll be the coach, mentor, and standard-setter for the product team — building careers, raising the craft bar, and creating the kind of environment where ambitious product people do their best work. You'll be equal parts strategist, people leader, and product craftsperson.</p> <h3>What You'll Own</h3> <p>You'll lead product across the Joblogic platform, including:</p> <ul> <li>End-to-end FSM and CAFM platform strategy</li> <li>AI-first product initiatives — copilots, agents, predictive maintenance, intelligent scheduling, document intelligence</li> <li>Reactive, PPM, and contract workflows</li> <li>Scheduling, dispatch, and optimisation</li> <li>Field engineer mobile experience</li> <li>Asset lifecycle management</li> <li>Quoting → job → invoicing flows</li> <li>Customer portals and self-service</li> <li>Data, reporting, analytics, and embedded BI</li> <li>Vertical-specific FM workflows (HVAC, M&amp;E, FM, building maintenance)</li> <li>Platform, integrations, and developer experience</li> </ul> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <h3>1. Set Product Vision &amp; Strategy</h3> <ul> <li>Define and communicate a compelling 1–3 year product vision aligned to Joblogic's £100M ARR ambition.</li> <li>Translate market trends, customer insight, and competitive dynamics into a clear, prioritised portfolio roadmap.</li> <li>Make sharp build / buy / partner / sunset decisions across the platform.</li> <li>Partner with the CEO, CPO, CTO, CRO, and CCO to align product strategy with commercial and GTM strategy.</li> </ul> <h3>2. Lead the AI-First Product Agenda</h3> <ul> <li>Own Joblogic's AI product strategy across LLMs, ML, agents, and predictive analytics.</li> <li>Identify the highest-value AI use cases across FSM and CAFM workflows — from intelligent scheduling and dynamic dispatch to predictive maintenance, automated quoting, and engineer copilots.</li> <li>Set principles for responsible, safe, and explainable AI — including data, privacy, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop design.</li> <li>Stay close to the rapidly evolving AI landscape (foundation models, agentic patterns, RAG, fine-tuning, evals) and translate it into pragmatic product bets.</li> <li>Partner with engineering and data leadership to shape the AI platform, data architecture, and ML lifecycle.</li> </ul> <h3>3. Mentor, Coach &amp; Lead a High-Performing Product Team</h3> <ul> <li>Hire, mentor, and develop Product Managers, Senior PMs, and Group PMs across the portfolio — making people growth a core part of how you spend your week.</li> <li>Run regular 1:1s, career conversations, and development plans tailored to each PM's strengths, goals, and growth areas.</li> <li>Coach PMs through complex trade-offs, stakeholder management, difficult prioritisation calls, and high-stakes customer situations.</li> <li>Set the standard for discovery, product craft, written communication, and commercial thinking — and actively raise the bar through feedback and pairing.</li> <li>Establish clear team structure, ownership, levelling, and career paths as the function scales.</li> <li>Build a strong performance culture: clear expectations, candid feedback, recognition, and the courage to make hard people decisions when needed.</li> <li>Foster a psychologically safe, inclusive environment where customer obsession, evidence-led decisions, and outcome ownership thrive.</li> <li>Invest in the team's craft — running PRD reviews, discovery clinics, AI literacy sessions, and post-mortems.</li> </ul> <h3>4. Drive Discovery &amp; Customer Insight at Scale</h3> <ul> <li>Embed deep, continuous discovery across the product team — customer calls, field visits, usage analytics, and qualitative research.</li> <li>Maintain a strong personal connection to customers, engineers, planners, and contract managers.</li> <li>Synthesise insight across verticals to identify portfolio-level opportunities and risks.</li> <li>Champion design partner programs and beta cohorts for new AI and platform capabilities.</li> </ul> <h3>5. Partner With UX, Engineering &amp; Data</h3> <ul> <li>Work hand-in-hand with Design and Engineering leadership to ship simple, scalable, beautifully crafted products.</li> <li>Set quality bars for usability, performance, reliability, and AI behaviour.</li> <li>Ensure mobile and web experiences feel like one cohesive, modern product.</li> <li>Drive a strong data and experimentation culture — from instrumentation to A/B testing to outcome reporting.</li> </ul> <h3>6. Own Commercial &amp; Outcome Accountability</h3> <ul> <li>Own product-led inputs to ARR growth, retention, expansion, and adoption.</li> <li>Define and track product KPIs and OKRs at portfolio and team level.</li> <li>Partner with Sales, CS, and Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing, and launches.</li> <li>Represent product externally — with customers, partners, analysts, investors, and at industry events.</li> </ul> <h3>7. Shape the Operating Model</h3> <ul> <li>Define how product, design, and engineering work together — rituals, planning cadence, roadmap reviews, discovery operations.</li> <li>Scale the function from a single-product mindset to a multi-product, platform-led operating model.</li> <li>Improve roadmap transparency, prioritisation frameworks, and cross-team dependencies.</li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <h3>Must-Have (Non-Negotiable)</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Extensive, proven experience in product management, including substantial experience directly managing and mentoring product managers</strong> in B2B SaaS.</li> <li>Proven <strong>people leadership and mentoring track record</strong> — you've built teams from the ground up, developed PMs into Senior PMs and beyond, and can point to specific people whose careers you've helped shape.</li> <li>Proven track record of shipping and scaling <strong>AI-powered products</strong> — from problem framing through to production, evaluation, and adoption.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on understanding of <strong>modern AI/ML and GenAI capabilities</strong>: LLMs, agents, RAG, evals, prompt and context engineering, model selection, fine-tuning, and ML lifecycle trade-offs.</li> <li>Broad product expertise across multiple domains — workflows, platform, mobile, data, integrations — and the ability to set strategy across all of them.</li> <li>Experience in Field Service Management, Facilities Management, CAFM/CMMS, Construction Tech, or an adjacent vertical SaaS domain.</li> <li>Strong commercial instinct: comfortable owning revenue-impacting decisions, pricing, packaging, and ROI cases.</li> <li>Demonstrated success building, hiring, retaining, and growing product teams of 5–20+ people.</li> <li>Excellent strategic communication — able to translate complex problems into clear narratives for the board, customers, and engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h3>People Leadership &amp; Mentoring</h3> <ul> <li>A natural mentor — you genuinely enjoy growing other people and take pride in their wins.</li> <li>Skilled at giving direct, kind, actionable feedback — and equally skilled at receiving it.</li> <li>Comfortable having hard conversations: performance, levelling, role changes, and tough prioritisation calls.</li> <li>Strong emotional intelligence — you read teams well, spot burnout early, and create space for people to do their best work.</li> <li>Track record of hiring exceptional product talent and building diverse, inclusive teams.</li> <li>Able to flex coaching style — from new PMs needing structure to senior PMs needing sounding-board sparring.</li> </ul> <h3>Product &amp; Leadership Skills</h3> <ul> <li>Strong product craft: discovery, prioritisation, written specs, systems thinking, and outcome orientation.</li> <li>Ability to operate at multiple altitudes — from 3-year strategy to specific PRDs and AI evaluation criteria.</li> <li>Comfortable navigating ambiguity, complex stakeholders, and competing priorities.</li> <li>Data- and evidence-led decision making, balanced with strong product intuition.</li> <li>Influence without authority across executive, commercial, and technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to Have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience scaling product in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS environment.</li> <li>Exposure to international expansion (Europe, North America).</li> <li>Background in scheduling, optimisation, IoT, or operations research.</li> <li>Experience launching agentic or copilot experiences in B2B workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with APIs, marketplaces, and partner ecosystems.</li> <li>Engineering, data science, or design background.</li> </ul> <h3>Why This Role Matters</h3> <p>Joblogic is evolving from a traditional FSM tool into an AI-first, workflow-intelligent, vertical-focused platform — and the Product Director is the single most important hire in shaping that future.</p> <p>In this role, you'll directly influence:</p> <ul> <li>How 100,000+ users experience Joblogic every day</li> <li>Where and how AI shows up across the platform</li> <li>How quickly we expand into CAFM and international markets</li> <li>The product culture, craft, and bar for the next 100 hires</li> <li>Our path from £25M to £100M ARR</li> </ul> <p>If you want to lead product at a scale where strategy, AI, and execution all matter — and where your decisions show up in the working day of thousands of engineers, planners, and service teams — this is the role.</p> <h3>Joblogic Values</h3> <p>At Joblogic, we expect our team members to champion and embed our core values across their work and customer interactions:</p> <ul> <li>Respect – We value every individual and treat colleagues and customers with professionalism, fairness and empathy</li> <li>Obsession with Customers – We place customer outcomes at the centre of everything we do, striving to deliver meaningful value and exceptional experiences</li> <li>Accountability – We take ownership of our actions, decisions and results, holding ourselves and each other to high standards</li> <li>Rethink Tomorrow – We embrace innovation, challenge the status quo and continuously improve how we work to shape a better future</li> </ul> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager, New Business DACH & Benelux
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://customers.twilio.com/" data-sk="tooltip_parent">&nbsp;hundreds of thousands of businesses&nbsp;</a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p> <p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p> <p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p> <p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!&nbsp;</p> <p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.&nbsp;<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p> <p>Join the team as Twilio’s next&nbsp;Sales Senior Manager, New Business Accounts DACH &amp; Benelux.</p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>This position is needed to lead one of our New Business Account Executive teams selling into DACH &amp; Benelux within the EMEA Region. Reporting into our EMEA Regional Vice President for South &amp; DACH, the right person for this role is an experienced sales leader who is adept at building high-performing teams of solution-selling Account Executives disciplined in driving new logo acquisition and expanding market presence.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Build and manage a high performing team of account executives focused on acquiring new enterprise customers and driving new logo growth.</li> <li>Coach and lead a team to identify and execute targeted outbound prospecting strategies across the entire portfolio of Twilio Products.</li> <li>Enable and coach your team around how to engage across various levels of customer maturity and segmentation.</li> <li>Work closely with our Marketing, Professional Services &amp; Partner teams to build a robust pipeline and accelerate time-to-value for new prospects.</li> <li>Forecast your team overachieving on their goals, and deftly present your guidance to your management</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p> <p><strong>*Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of managerial experience within a high performing CPaaS, Communications or API based company.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in building teams, driving pipeline creation, managing monthly forecasting, supporting fiscal planning, and tracking revenue for new business accounts.</li> <li>Experience managing a remote team spread across different countries.&nbsp;</li> <li>Consistent track record of exceeding revenue targets and business objectives.</li> <li>Industry experience in selling CPaaS or SaaS and managing complex sales negotiations.&nbsp;</li> <li>Highly analytical and data driven; an innovative thinker and creative problem solver who is naturally curious.</li> <li>A self-starter who can work with minimal supervision to drive results.</li> <li>Comfortable with ambiguity and working cross-functionally in a high growth business landscape.</li> <li>BA/BS degree or equivalent required.&nbsp;</li> <li>Energy and enthusiasm with a willingness to travel.&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong executive presence.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organisation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>This role will be remote, and based in UK, Ireland or Spain.</p> <p><strong>Travel&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p> <p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p> <p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a></p> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p> <p>We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @<a href="http://twilio.com">twilio.com</a> email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.<br><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</strong> We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Scientist
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! THE ROLE We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our award-winning Data Science team at a pivotal moment. Carwow operates a two-sided marketplace — connecting car buyers and sellers at scale — and data science sits at the heart of how we make that marketplace smarter, faster, and more valuable for everyone in it. In fact, we recently won GenAI initiative of the Year at the British Data Awards. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role working centrally across the business. You'll partner with teams spanning Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations — developing and deploying ML and AI solutions that drive outcomes across both sides of our marketplace. The problems you'll work on are genuinely varied: pricing models, propensity and demand signals that sharpen marketing spend, personalised recommendations for our web product and CRM, and LLM-powered solutions for operational challenges like document verification. You'll translate ambiguous business problems into structured, production-ready solutions — and you'll be expected to deliver them end-to-end, from first principles through to being deployment-ready and beyond. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING End-to-End ML & AI Delivery: Lead data science initiatives from problem framing through to deployment, monitoring, and iteration — delivering the full production lifecycle. With no dedicated ML engineering function, you'll be responsible for ensuring your solutions are robust, scalable, and performing in the real world long after they ship. GenAI & LLM Application: Design and build LLM-powered solutions where they create genuine business value — document processing, intelligent search, content understanding, and beyond. Apply them alongside classical ML with clear judgement about where each approach earns its place. Commercial Impact: Connect your work directly to business outcomes. Whether you're building a model to improve marketing efficiency, a pricing signal to sharpen commercial decisions, or a recommendation engine to increase conversion — you understand the business lever you're pulling and design your solutions accordingly. Prototyping & Experimentation: Move fast to test ideas before committing to full-scale development. Define rigorous success metrics upfront, validate honestly, and know when to double down and when to walk away. Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations stakeholders to understand problems deeply before reaching for a solution. Translate findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences. Standards & Craft: Contribute to shared best practices, documentation, and ways of working that raise the bar for the data science function — and help more junior team members grow alongside you. Drive continued adoption of AI capabilities to drive efficiencies, automation and constantly leverage new capabilities. WHAT YOU'LL NEED Please note: We know that no candidate will be the perfect match for all we've listed in this posting, so we’d encourage you to apply if you feel you're close to the brief but not an exact match. Ideally you’ll have Commercial Mindset: You think about business impact first. You understand how your models connect to revenue, efficiency, or customer outcomes — and you use that to prioritise, scope, and communicate your work. Stakeholder Partnership: Proven ability to work with commercial, marketing, and product stakeholders — translating business problems into well-scoped solutions and communicating technical solutions, challenges and outcomes clearly at all levels. Sound Judgement: You navigate the tooling landscape with clear eyes — knowing when classical ML is right, when GenAI unlocks something new, and when a simpler solution is the more honest answer. Strong instincts for scalability, reliability, and explainability. [Bonus] Marketplace or Two-Sided Platform Experience: Understanding of supply/demand dynamics and how data science creates leverage in a marketplace context. TEHCNICAL SKILLSET Proven ML Experience: A strong track record of building, deploying, and maintaining ML models in Python in a production environment — not just notebooks. You've owned models after they ship and know how to keep them healthy. Full-Lifecycle Delivery (MLOps): Comfortable delivering the end-to-end production lifecycle — model training, versioning, monitoring, and champion/challenger experimentation — without relying on a dedicated ML engineering team to carry that responsibility. GenAI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You understand how to apply, evaluate, and extend these tools — and you're honest about where they fall short. Technical Depth: Solid experience in a cloud ML environment with software engineering principles — version control, code reviews, unit testing, and familiarity with containerisation. Quantitative Rigour: Strong foundation in statistical evaluation and experiment design. You can define and defend success metrics, and you know when a model is degrading and what to do about it. [Bonus] Experience with VertexAI TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES Languages: Python, SQL Data & Transformation: dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery Visualisation & BI: Looker Engineering & MLOps: Docker, GitHub Workflow & Orchestration: Vertex AI Pipelines (GCP), Kubeflow LLMs & GenAI: Gemini API, Claude API INTERVIEW PROCESS Step 1: People Team Screening Call (30 min) Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min) Step 3: Technical Task: covering both Modelling & Production with Presentation (60 min + Task) Step 4: Values Interview (45 min) WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Hybrid working Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement Share options - when we thrive, so do you! Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays 28 days annual leave 1 day for your wedding 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work! For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year Work from abroad for a month Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Customer Success Manager - UK
description: About You You're a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You're a self-starter who's good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You've worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they're happy they partnered with you. Further, you're a curious person, and you'd love the opportunity to work with a technology team that includes data scientists, algorithm experts, back-end and front-end engineers to expand your knowledge. About Us Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. About The Position As a Customer Success Manager, you'll be joining a rapidly growing team that helps our customers increase their revenue by improving the search and product discovery experiences of their websites and mobile apps through integrating with our services. Your specific responsibilities will include: Own the customer journey from project kick-off, launch, adoption, and ongoing value realization, ensuring customers achieve meaningful business outcomes and are delighted with the partnership. Build trusted relationships across complex enterprise organizations, engaging confidently with stakeholders ranging from engineers, data and product teams to Heads and Directors of Ecommerce, Digital, Product, and Technology, as well as VP and C-level executives. Understand the goals, priorities, and influence of different customer personas, and align technical and business stakeholders around a shared success plan. Translate technical concepts, product capabilities, and performance data into clear business value, connecting Constructor’s work to outcomes such as conversion, revenue, customer experience, and operational efficiency. Plan and lead effective QBRs and EBRs that go beyond reporting: communicate measurable impact, facilitate strategic conversations, make recommendations, and align stakeholders on priorities and next steps. About You


You're a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You're a self-starter who's good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You've worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they're happy they partnered with you. About Us

Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical.

We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. title: Associate Director, Medical Affairs
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Director, Medical Affairs based in France. As Associate Director, Medical Affairs, you will serve as a scientific leader and subject-matter expert across a broad range of Medical Affairs activities. You will independently lead high-value workstreams spanning thought leader engagement, scientific congresses, medical communications, publications, literature surveillance, and insight generation. The role combines external scientific engagement with strategic ownership of programs that support the product lifecycle. You will translate clinical evidence and stakeholder insights into practical recommendations that shape Medical Affairs priorities. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and provide trained backup support for selected Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities. This is a remote opportunity within a purpose-driven, collaborative healthcare environment, with approximately 20% travel for congresses and external engagements. Accountabilities Serve as a scientific subject-matter expert, translating clinical evidence, stakeholder insights, and emerging scientific developments into balanced, actionable recommendations for Medical Affairs strategy. Develop and maintain compliant relationships with key thought leaders (KTLs), healthcare professionals, and other external scientific experts. Plan and conduct scientific exchanges, advisory boards, roundtables, consensus initiatives, and other external engagements aligned with Medical Affairs objectives. Develop KTL engagement plans, define interaction objectives, document scientific insights, and coordinate appropriate follow-up with Medical Affairs leadership. Provide scientific coverage at national and selected regional congresses, including program assessment, session prioritization, coverage planning, KTL preparation, insight capture, and post-congress reporting. Lead the scientific strategy and execution of Medical Affairs booths, including educational content, scientific exchange, medical inquiry routing, insight collection, and post-congress analysis. Partner with Medical Affairs Operations on congress logistics, vendors, contracts, and budget administration. Lead or support scientific communications, including medical education materials, congress resources, presentations, standard response letters, FAQs, and other non-promotional materials. Support publication activities such as publication planning, literature reviews, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and white papers in accordance with applicable governance processes. Conduct literature surveillance and synthesize relevant scientific, clinical, safety, and competitive developments, identifying implications for evidence generation, education, and stakeholder engagement. Aggregate and analyze insights from KTL interactions, congresses, advisory boards, Medical Information, surveys, and research activities to identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities. Represent Medical Affairs on cross-functional teams and provide scientific expertise to Regulatory, Quality, Commercial, and other internal stakeholders as appropriate. Serve as a trained and designated backup for defined Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities, including medical inquiry review or escalation, safety information escalation, and selected product complaint assessments. Support continuous improvement across Medical Affairs processes while maintaining high standards of scientific quality, compliance, and risk management. Requirements Advanced scientific or healthcare degree such as a PharmD, PhD, MD, DO, or another relevant advanced degree. Four or more years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience preferred, including experience within Medical Affairs. Strong scientific and clinical acumen, including knowledge of medical terminology, clinical study design, biostatistics, evidence appraisal, and interpretation of clinical and real-world evidence. Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and synthesize complex scientific, clinical, safety, and technical information and translate findings into clear, balanced recommendations. Strong scientific writing and communication capabilities, including experience developing medical education materials, evidence summaries, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, presentations, and other scientific content. Working knowledge of publication standards, copyright requirements, scientific exchange principles, and applicable Medical Affairs laws, regulations, industry guidance, and internal requirements. Ability to establish credible and compliant relationships with KTLs, healthcare professionals, and external scientific experts. Strong presentation skills and the ability to adapt complex scientific information for scientific, executive, and cross-functional audiences. Strategic thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to connect scientific evidence and stakeholder insights with broader Medical Affairs priorities. Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence cross-functional stakeholders while maintaining appropriate Medical Affairs independence. Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, complex workstreams, and time-sensitive deliverables. Ability to aggregate and synthesize insights to identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities. Strong awareness of quality, compliance, and risk, including the ability to recognize and appropriately escalate safety, product quality, and compliance information. Prior experience in Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, or product complaints is preferred; the ability to complete role-based training and provide designated backup support is required. Experience with KTL engagement, scientific exchange, congress planning or coverage, and scientific communications is preferred. Strong organizational, stakeholder-management, communication, and presentation skills. High degree of accountability, adaptability, integrity, discretion, and commitment to continuous improvement. Ability to work independently within a lean, cross-functional environment and exercise sound judgment when managing competing priorities and potential risks. Fluent English communication skills and willingness to travel overnight up to approximately 20%, including for scientific congresses and external stakeholder engagements. Flexibility to occasionally work evenings or weekends when required by congress schedules or external engagements. Benefits Competitive base salary range of  $150,000–$180,000 , depending on experience, education, skills, and geographic location. Eligibility for an annual performance bonus. Comprehensive employee benefits package. Remote working arrangement. Approximately 20% travel, providing opportunities for scientific congress participation and external stakeholder engagement. Opportunity to take visible ownership of high-impact Medical Affairs programs. Exposure to scientific strategy, evidence generation, external engagement, and the full product lifecycle. Opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, purpose-driven healthcare environment. Meaningful opportunity to contribute to the development and support of potentially life-saving healthcare products. Strong scope for scientific leadership, cross-functional influence, and professional growth. The role is focused on commercial partnerships and lead generation—not technical integrations. The initial priority is to build the Accounting and Travel & E-commerce channels across France and Spain. A deep, activatable network in at least one priority vertical, with access to senior decision-makers. Strong strategic judgement and hands-on execution: you can define the strategy and personally open the first doors, lead key meetings and progress strategic partnerships. Strategic and hands-on: you can set direction while staying close to partners, pipeline and commercial details. Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

Requirements

Today, we're looking for our Global VP of Talent Acquisition to build and lead our Ai-native shift and create the dream team for our next stage of growth. This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership challenge for designing a scalable, data-driven talent acquisition function across all regions in the world (North America, Europe, and APAC), all functions and levels -from AI expert to GTM and from Mid-level to Executives. You'll partner directly with the executive team and hiring managers to ensure we attract, hire, and onboard the talent needed to hit our growth targets, while building a TA function that's efficient, candidate-centric, and built for scale.

Because it’s instrumental to the strategy, this role will report directly to the CEO.

What you would do:

  • Strategy & Leadership: Define and own the global talent acquisition strategy, aligning hiring plans with headcount budgets, business goals, and workforce planning across all regions.
  • Team Management: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global TA team, including regional leads, recruiters, sourcers, and coordinators; set goals, coach performance, and grow internal talent.
  • Executive & Leadership Hiring: Personally in charge of hiring senior C-level roles with the CEO.
  • Process & Scale: Design and continuously improve AI Agents for recruiting processes, workflows, and SLAs to ensure a consistent, efficient, and high-quality hiring experience.
  • Employer Brand: Own the company's employer brand and candidate value proposition globally; partner with Marketing and Comms to strengthen our reputation as an employer of choice.
  • Data & Metrics: Establish TA metrics and dashboards (time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, quality-of-hire, pipeline conversion, diversity metrics) and use data to drive decisions and report to the executive team and board.
  • Systems & Tools: Own the ATS and recruiting tech stack; evaluate and implement tools (sourcing, assessment, AI-enabled recruiting tools, CRM) to improve efficiency and candidate experience.
  • DEI: Champion diverse and inclusive hiring practices globally, ensuring equitable processes across all regions.
  • Global & Compliance: Ensure hiring practices comply with local labor laws and regulations across all operating countries; manage relationships with external agencies, RPOs, and immigration/visa partners as needed.
  • Budget Ownership: Own the TA budget, including headcount, tooling, agency spend, and employer branding investments.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Act as a strategic advisor to hiring managers and executives on org design, market talent trends, compensation benchmarking, and hiring strategy.

 What we are looking for:

  • 10+ years in talent acquisition, with 5+ years in a senior TA leadership role (VP, Head of TA, or similar) at a SaaS or high-growth AI company.
  • Proven experience building and scaling global TA functions across multiple countries/regions (US, Europe)
  • Track record of personally hiring C-Levels
  • Experience operating in a mid-size, fast-growing company environment
  • Hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves approach balanced with strategic, big-picture thinking.
  • Experience managing distributed, cross-cultural teams.
  • Natural ability to convince and motivate C-Level candidates to join our AI strategy.
  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable building and presenting TA metrics and forecasts to executive leadership and the board.
  • Deep knowledge of modern sourcing strategies, employer branding, and recruiting technology (AI Recruiter Agents, ATS, CRM).
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence and partner with senior executives.
  • Strong understanding of global employment law and compliance considerations related to hiring.

Because when you thrive, we all succeed! 

We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know. 

Agencies 

We only accept applications from invited agencies via our Workable portal. Unsolicited CVs sent to managers or HR won’t be subject to fees.

⭐️ The Account Executive (Small Businesses) job

Your mission

Join our Small Businesses team targeting companies with 10-30 employees across tech, consulting, and business services, the market segment where Alan has the strongest product-market fit and brand recognition. You'll work in a high-velocity environment with strong conversion rates, and the opportunity to make an immediate impact on hundreds of growing French companies.

What you'll own

  • Full sales cycle: From prospection to closing

  • Strategic relationships: Drive deals and manage key customer relationships

  • Education & demos: Deliver inspiring product demonstrations and guide stakeholders through the evaluation process

The Alan way of selling

We've developed the Alan Smart & Soft selling method:

  • Smart: Leverage precise messaging and materials to educate and inspire

  • Soft: Create tailored, high-touch strategies for each prospect

  • Experience: Deliver a seamless journey that reflects Alan's customer-first approach

Beyond sales

As an Alan team member, you'll:

  • Shape our product evolution

  • Contribute to improving our methods and strategy

  • Participate in growth initiatives

  • Be part of a collaborative team that thinks big

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through technology and human connection 🌟

Meet Estelle Berdugo one of our Account Executives.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Small Businesses Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 3 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It's becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what's actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart's first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart's scale, data, and reach behind us, we're building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join the Data team, the backbone behind every data-driven decision at Vibe, from internal operations to the reporting advertisers check every day. The team runs three interlocking stacks: a batch platform that feeds Product, Sales, Finance, and ML; a real-time streaming layer that powers spend tracking and retargeting; and a reporting stack built on ClickHouse Cloud and Cube that serves sub-second analytics through Vibe's Clear platform. This role exists because bid, win, and impression volumes are growing as fast as the business, and the platform needs an owner who can turn that scale into reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure rather than a growing pile of incidents. You'll get end-to-end ownership of systems the business can't run without, direct influence over the tools every data, ML, and analytics engineer at Vibe uses daily, and a mandate to treat performance and cost as core engineering problems, not afterthoughts.

What You'll Do

Platform & Services Ownership

  • Design and operate real-time event processing on Kafka at production scale

  • Build and run batch orchestration pipelines on Dagster

  • Own the serving path into ClickHouse Cloud from ingestion through query

  • Drive projects end-to-end from stakeholder requirements through post-launch iteration

  • Set architecture decisions on partitioning, materialization, retention, and compute sizing

Developer Enablement & Tooling

  • Build orchestration patterns and testing frameworks the whole team relies on

  • Establish CI/CD and data contracts that reduce manual review overhead

  • Turn recurring one-off fixes into reusable, documented building blocks

  • Design self-serve infrastructure that teams adopt without being told to

Reliability & Operational Excellence

  • Build alerting and dashboards that catch issues before users feel them

  • Set SLOs that reflect real business risk, not vanity metrics

  • Lead incident response during on-call rotations

  • Write runbooks and automation that shorten and reduce pages

  • Anticipate scaling limits before bid/win log growth turns them into incidents

Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Profile and optimize services across Kafka, Spark, DuckDB, and ClickHouse

  • Treat compute and storage spend as a first-class engineering metric

  • Lead cost reviews on the platform's most expensive systems

  • Instrument the platform to catch cost regressions early

Cross-Team Partnership

  • Translate ambiguous requests from data, ML, and product engineers into concrete deliverables

  • Push back on requests that aren't ready or aren't the right approach

  • Influence upstream teams on schema, semantics, and SLAs

  • Brief senior stakeholders on tradeoffs and decisions, not implementation detail

What You Need

  • 5+ years building and operating distributed, data-intensive systems in production

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or Rust, with real testing and code review discipline

  • Production experience with several of: Kafka, Spark, Iceberg or object storage, ClickHouse or similar column-store analytics

  • Experience owning services from code to production, including AWS, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code

  • A track record of measurably improving performance or cost on specific systems, and the ability to explain why

  • Strong cross-functional communication, including the judgment to push back on stakeholders with conflicting priorities

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in programmatic or streaming TV advertising

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  2. Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  3. Technical Interview — A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together.

  4. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  5. Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

  6. Reference checks — Two calls, handled with discretion.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

You'll join the Integrations team, the connective tissue of Vibe's platform, reporting directly to the Engineering Manager. The team owns all data flowing in and out of Vibe: measurement and attribution integrations, audience connections from CRMs and CDPs, and reporting pipelines. This role exists because we're building a first-class Developer Platform, opening Vibe's full capabilities as an API so external partners can build on top of us. Three reasons to want this: you'll be a senior voice on a team that operates at the center of Vibe's growth, you'll own foundational architecture decisions on a platform that marquee partners like Clay are already building against, and you'll work in an environment where AI-augmented development is the expectation, not the experiment.
